integrity: For a nonadjacent same-part pair, every third vertex has equal distance to the two endpoints, so the pair can be distinguished only by one endpoint. This reduces nonlocal resolution to selecting all but at most one vertex from each non-singleton part. The dimension, enumerator, and basis count follow by independent partwise counting. A standalone verifier checks all complete multipartite isomorphism types through order ten directly from graph distances.
scientific_limitations: The complete-bipartite scalar case is already contained in the defining nonlocal-metric-dimension paper.
The new claim is the arbitrary complete-multipartite all-set classification, factorized cardinality enumerator, and complete basis count.
Only the standard vertex nonlocal metric dimension is considered; local, edge, multiset, and other resolving variants are outside scope.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed arbitrary complete-multipartite treatment may exist despite targeted searches.
title: All nonlocal resolving sets of complete multipartite graphs
